clue.text: Give a porter tips? Right!

indicators.note: to tip is to upset or tip over, so the letters of the three words before it are tumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether to hand a hotel porter some gratuities, and decides yes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tips' looks like money for the porter, but it is the anagram signal over GIVE A PORTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A prerogative is an exclusive privilege or entitlement, which is a right.

clue.text: Bitterness enlisted soldier voiced

indicators.note: voiced means spoken out, so the soldier's word is replaced by one that sounds like it

parts.note: a ranker is a soldier in the ranks rather than an officer

explanation.surface: A private soldier expresses his resentment.
explanation.walkthrough: A RANKER is an ordinary enlisted soldier; said in a non-rhotic British accent it matches the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is lasting bitterness or resentment, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Call dealer to guarantee and protect funds

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them on the phone
a fence is a dealer in stolen goods

explanation.surface: A suggestion to phone a dealer to secure your money.
explanation.walkthrough: A FENCE is slang for someone who buys and sells stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring-fence money is to set it aside so it is guaranteed for one purpose and protected.

clue.text: Pull up to take in a mark giving range

indicators.note: take in means to contain, so the other pieces go inside
in a down clue, up means the word for pull is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to tug is to pull
M is the abbreviation for mark, an old German currency

explanation.surface: An instruction to stop and collect a grade that spans a range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns TUG into GUT, and 'to take in' puts A and M inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamut is the whole range or scope of something, as in running the gamut.

clue.text: Screen facility of excessively liberal lawyers

parts.note: too means to an excessive degree
L is the abbreviation for Liberal, as in the political party
the bar is the collective name for barristers

explanation.surface: A screen feature belonging to lawyers who are overly progressive.
explanation.walkthrough: The Bar is the legal profession of barristers in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A toolbar is a strip of icons on a computer screen, a facility for the user.

clue.text: Approves personality offering service

indicators.note: the two words offer up the run of letters spanning their join

explanation.surface: A person's character earns approval, and they lead a religious service.
explanation.definitionFit: Vespers is the evening church service of prayer in the Christian tradition.

clue.text: Huge and bulky, the plane flies in, on time at last

indicators.note: flies suggests the letters scattering through the air into a new arrangement
at last points to the final letter of the word time

explanation.surface: An aircraft lands at the very last moment, enormous and heavy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flies' rearranges THE PLANE to give ELEPHANT; 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Elephantine describes something enormous and clumsy, like an elephant.

clue.text: Going out for example, storing books at home

indicators.note: storing means holding something inside, so the other pieces go within

parts.note: EG is the abbreviation for exempli gratia, for example
B stands for book, so BB is books
in means at home

explanation.surface: Departing, perhaps, while keeping books in the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going out' suggests leaving, but here it is the tide receding.
explanation.definitionFit: An ebbing tide is going out, flowing away from the shore.

clue.text: Country scheduled to follow the French embargo

indicators.note: to follow places the word for scheduled after the other pieces

parts.note: le is French for the
a ban is an embargo
on means scheduled, as in the match is on

explanation.surface: A country set to come after a French trade embargo.
explanation.definitionFit: Lebanon is a country on the eastern Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Red version of Taoism

indicators.note: a version of something is a reworked form of it, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A communist form of Chinese philosophy.
explanation.walkthrough: Red is a familiar term for a communist.
explanation.definitionFit: A Maoist is a follower of Mao's communism, and red means communist.

clue.text: Basic principle of a thought underpinning cash reserve

indicators.note: in a down clue, underpinning puts the pieces before it below the word for cash reserve

parts.note: a fund is a reserve of money
in the sense relating to thought, the adjective is mental

explanation.surface: A core idea about mind supporting a stockpile of money.
explanation.definitionFit: A fundamental, as a noun, is a basic rule or principle on which others rest.

clue.text: Penny, with help on holiday, is financially settled

parts.note: aid means help
off means away from work, as in a day off

explanation.surface: Someone called Penny, helped while away on holiday, has her debts cleared.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penny' looks like a woman's name, but is just the coin's abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Something paid off has been fully settled, with no money still owing.

clue.text: Bill left with Vichy water — such a theatrical scene!

parts.note: a tab is a bill, as in pick up the tab
eau is French for water, Vichy being a French town

explanation.surface: Paying the bill with bottled spa water is quite a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: Vichy is a French spa town, so its water is the French word for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tableau is a striking motionless group of people arranged as on a stage.

clue.text: Risks unbounded wrath

indicators.note: without bounds means losing the first and last letters of the word for risks

parts.note: dangers are risks

explanation.surface: Danger provokes fury without limits.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrath is extreme anger, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Edison worried about pitch being legally authenticated

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the rearranged name goes round the word for pitch
worried means troubled or shaken up, so the name's letters are rearranged

parts.note: tar is pitch, the black sticky substance

explanation.surface: The inventor Edison frets over a tar pitch being certified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' makes NOISED from the inventor's name, and 'about' puts it around the pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: A document notarised has been certified by a notary, making it legally valid.

clue.text: Specialist unit's tense request on behalf of Church

parts.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
to ask is to request
for means on behalf of
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A specialist team makes a tense appeal on behalf of the church.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'unit' stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A task force is a group set up for a particular operation, a specialist unit.

clue.text: Books hotel and runs into workers of the soil

indicators.note: into means the pieces before it go inside the word for farm workers

parts.note: tillers are people who till or cultivate the land
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Someone reserves a hotel and bumps into farmers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Books' looks like a verb (reserves), but it is the definition, a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrillers are exciting novels of crime or suspense, a kind of book.

clue.text: Show consideration for particular detail

definitions.meaning: to esteem or regard someone with care
an aspect or point, as in 'in every way'

explanation.definitionFit: To respect someone is to show regard for them; and a respect is a particular point or aspect.

clue.text: Reduce one in length, possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Shorten something by one unit of length, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link: I joins LENGTH and 'possibly' rearranges the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: To lighten a load is to reduce its weight.

clue.text: True origin of magic kingdom

parts.note: real means true or genuine

indicators.note: the origin of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: The real source of a magical kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a kingdom, the land ruled by a monarch.

clue.text: Steps down, concerned with omens

parts.note: re means about or concerning
signs are omens or portents

explanation.surface: Someone quits office after worrying about portents.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to give up a post, or step down from it.

clue.text: A survey on old American space mission

parts.note: a poll is a survey of opinion

explanation.surface: A survey about an old US space programme.
explanation.definitionFit: Apollo was the NASA programme that landed people on the Moon.

clue.text: Mature returns collected by curious bunch

indicators.note: collected by means held within the word for curious

parts.note: nosy means curious or prying

indicators.note: returns means the word for mature goes back the other way

parts.note: to age is to mature

explanation.surface: An older person's comeback is gathered up by an inquisitive group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mature' looks like an adjective but is the verb; 'returns' makes EGA, which sits inside the word for curious.
explanation.definitionFit: A nosegay is a small bunch of flowers.

clue.text: Put up volunteers for Second World War conference

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for put is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to lay something is to put it down
the TA, or Territorial Army, was Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A volunteer force hosts a wartime summit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up' reads as housing someone, but 'up' just turns LAY into YAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Yalta was the 1945 meeting of Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin in Crimea.

clue.text: Garland often so properly arranged

indicators.note: putting the letters into proper order means rearranging them

explanation.surface: A wreath of flowers, frequently put in place carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: To festoon is to decorate with hanging chains of flowers, just as to garland is.

clue.text: Study account mainly relating to canines

parts.note: a den is a private room for study

indicators.note: mainly means most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: a tale is an account or story

explanation.surface: A study report that is largely about dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canines' suggests dogs, but they are the pointed teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: Dental means concerning teeth, and canines are teeth.

clue.text: Ceremonial dress of royal diva oddly going missing

parts.note: regal means royal

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters of the word diva are dropped, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A royal singer's state robes go missing, curiously.
explanation.definitionFit: Regalia are the insignia and robes worn on ceremonial occasions.

clue.text: Order a rib after rise

indicators.note: after places the pieces before it after the word for rise

parts.note: to stand is to rise
to rib someone is to tease them

explanation.surface: A command to poke fun at someone once they've got up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Order' looks like a verb, but it is the noun: a drill command.
explanation.definitionFit: Stand at ease is a military drill command, an order to relax position.
